 ORDER

This writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed by the petitioners seeking the following reliefs:-
"I Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondents to stop the reconstruction and widening activities of Sundersi-Polayankala Road till the acquisition be done and compensation is paid to the petitioners in accordance with Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: II Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondents to pay compensation to the petitioners for taking over the possession of the agriculture land of the petitioners for reconstruction and widening activities of Sundersi Polayankala Road as per the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 III

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 III
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondents to pay Petitioner No. 1 adequate compensation in in accordance with the Land Acquisition Act, 1984 in lieu of the acquisition of his agricultural land done in the year 2009 for reconstruction and widening of Sundersi-Polayankala Road.
IV Any other relief deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case may be grated in favour of the petitioners.
V Costs of this Petition may kindly be awarded to the Petitioners."

The grievance of the petitioners is that the respondents are carrying out road construction activity on their land which is situated at survey No.757/1, 749 and 748 of village Khadi, Tehsil Polaykalan,
District Shajapur and the aforesaid construction is being carried out without any compensation to the petitioners and a representation in this regard was also submitted by the petitioners to the Collector but the same has still not been decided.
Counsel for the respondents/State has submitted that it is the respondent No.2 only which is carrying out the construction activity and the State has no orders for acquisition of the land.
In view of the same, without commenting upon the merits of the matter, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioners to file a fresh representation along with all relevant documents before the respondents No.2/competent authority within a period of two weeks which shall be decide by the respondents No.2/competent authority in accordance with law by a reasoned and speaking order within a further period of four weeks.
